territorial_scope.description: Applies to telephone calls placed with an automatic dialing-announcing device under the California Public Utilities Code.

evidence.quote: Whenever telephone calls are placed through the use of an automatic dialing-announcing device

summary.short: Amends California Public Utilities Code § 2874 so that automated calls using an automatic dialing-announcing device must, after a natural voice announcement, inform the person called if the prerecorded message uses an artificial voice, and defines artificial intelligence and artificial voice. Effective date not stated in text.
summary.long: AB 2905 amends Section 2874 of the California Public Utilities Code, which governs telephone calls placed with an automatic dialing-announcing device. Under the amended section, such a device may be operated only after an unrecorded, natural voice announcement by the calling person. The announcement must state the nature of the call and the name, address and telephone number of the business or organization represented, if any, and ask whether the called person consents to hear the prerecorded message. It must also inform the called person if the prerecorded message uses an artificial voice. The calling person must disconnect the device when the call terminates. Subdivision (c) defines artificial intelligence as an engineered or machine-based system that varies in its level of autonomy and can infer from its input how to generate outputs that influence physical or virtual environments, and defines an artificial voice as a voice generated or significantly altered using artificial intelligence. The text states no penalty, enforcement authority or private right of action. Section 2 states that no state reimbursement is required under Article XIII B, Section 6 of the California Constitution, because any local agency or school district costs arise from creating, eliminating or changing the penalty for a crime or infraction. The effective date is not stated in the text.

notes: The document is the bill text, not a consolidated code. The amended Section 2874 is reproduced in full with no visible markings of new or deleted words, so this annotation cannot separate added from unchanged text. The text gives no enactment or effective date. Subdivision (c)(2) defines 'artificial voice' by reference to the term 'artificial intelligence' defined in (c)(1).

thresholds.note: The bill contains no numeric cutoffs. It amends Public Utilities Code §2874 to require an unrecorded natural voice announcement and disclosure of an artificial voice in automated-dialing calls, with no size, value, or quantity tiers. The only numbers are section and subdivision numbering, and the Section 2 cost-reimbursement statement contains none.
